title: ipld/metadata.rs: as u64 casts can silently truncate on 32-bit
description: crates/core/src/ipld/metadata.rs: compute_byte_count and compute_line_count use 'as u64' casts on usize values. On 64-bit hosts this is fine, but 'as' casts are lossless truncation without a compile error on 32-bit. Fix: use u64::try_from(value).unwrap_or(u64::MAX) or a targeted lint suppression with a comment explaining the invariant.
